title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF supported the knowledge and capacity of parents, caregivers, Indigenous communities, and other stakeholders. This initiative has focused on implementing positive parenting and caregiving practices to reduce violence against children in homes, schools, and communities. Additionally, countries have updated their evidence base to better guide programmatic responses to violence prevention and juvenile offending.; ;;
